//: THIS FILE BELONGS TO THE HOST. Kept apart from the manifest on purpose: these are two authorities. The institution declares who it is and what it offers; the HOST decides how it is run and which folder it grants it. If the shell came in the manifest, the module would choose how it is run.
//paths: With forward slashes. Windows accepts them just the same and they avoid JSON's double escaping, which broke this file once already. And RELATIVE TO THIS FOLDER when not rooted: shell.arguments[0] is the dll that gets loaded, and the Host anchors it to the folder of this installation.json. That is what lets the versioned bench in Modulos/ start on any machine that has built the module (dotnet build Examenes/App/Examenes.Mcp), instead of carrying the disk of whoever assembled the POC. The real installer keeps writing absolute paths: the dll lives inside the module folder and both forms name the same file.
//shell: Stage 1: child process + stdio, because in this POC the module ships its own MCP server. Stage 2 changes ONLY this block for a wasm runtime with --dir, and neither the manifest nor the module notices. The granted folder is appended as the last argument; it does not go here.
//grantedFolder: The ONLY folder this module may touch. The module does not choose it: granting is an act of the granter. IT HAS TO BE THE SAME ONE you picked in the app when you installed it - if they do not match, the module will report hayDatos=false and Claude will ask you to open the app. This one is seeded with the refresh loop, against URL2 running (dotnet run --project Examenes/EndPointDeEventos): dotnet run --project Examenes/App/Examenes.Consola -- refrescar C:/Gnothi/examenes http://localhost:8091/ expediente 1. NOT with 'medir': that command is the console TEST HARNESS, and on purpose it appends to the folder a measurement that is a test case -a cholesterol of 360 mg/dL dated one day after the real 212- so what it leaves behind is not the person's record.
//enabled: The switch belongs to the Host. Disabled = Gnothi leaves this module's tools out of the list it hands the assistant, and the module does NOT find out: it cannot tell 'I was switched off' apart from 'nobody asked'.
//disabledTools: The fine cut, which is the one actually needed: 'the trend yes, the rate no'. Put the name here exactly as it appears in the manifest, without the module prefix.
